{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRENT NaN FEATURE BUG IN ml/features/encoder.py (6 SEPARATE OCCASIONS)

File: ml/features/encoder.py (ml pipeline side)
Common symptom across all occasions: NaN value in one output column
Common reproduction across all occasions: encode the batch holding the sparse column
Context: Same corner of ml/features/encoder.py throughout; context carried over between fixes

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-30]
- Trigger: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: Two writes not wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #1025, branch fix/nan-feature-1)
- Result: Throughput rose 71%, to 335 requests per second

OCCASION 2: [2026-02-10]
- Trigger: Tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #1510, branch fix/nan-feature-2)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 1.2 s to 675 ms

OCCASION 3: [2026-05-16]
- Trigger: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #3212, branch fix/nan-feature-3)
- Result: Reclaimed 58 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 4: [2026-05-25]
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
- Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #7766, branch fix/nan-feature-4)
- Result: Backlog cleared 61 minutes after the deploy

OCCASION 5: [2026-07-02]
- Trigger: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #8084, branch fix/nan-feature-5)
- Result: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 71 days running

OCCASION 6: [2026-08-04]
- Trigger: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #8674, branch fix/nan-feature-6)
- Result: Job finished in 84 minutes instead of 8 hours"}
